```{python}
# Include and execute your code here
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, ExtraTreeClassifier
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay
from sklearn.inspection import permutation_importance
import polars.selectors as cs
```

```{python}
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings(
    "ignore",
    message=r"X does not have valid feature names.*",
    category=UserWarning,
)
```

```{python}
# x = df.select(cs.numeric().exclude(["before1980","yrbuilt", "syear"]))
x= df.select(["gartype_Att", "quality_C", "stories", "numbaths","arcstyle_ONE-STORY","abstrprd","livearea","basement","nocars"])
y = df.select("before1980")

x_train, x_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(x, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=28)

```

```{python}
dt_classifier = DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=28)
dt_classifier.fit(x_train, y_train)

dt_pred = dt_classifier.predict(x_test)

print(classification_report(y_test, dt_pred))

dt_cm=confusion_matrix(y_test, dt_pred)
dt_disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix = dt_cm)

ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_estimator(dt_classifier, x_test, y_test, cmap="Blues")

```

```{python}
et_classifier = ExtraTreeClassifier(random_state=28)
et_classifier.fit(x_train, y_train)

et_pred = et_classifier.predict(x_test)

print(classification_report(y_test, et_pred))

et_cm=confusion_matrix(y_test, et_pred)
et_disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix = et_cm)

ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_estimator(et_classifier, x_test, y_test, cmap="Purples")

```

```{python}
hg_classifier = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=28)
hg_classifier.fit(x_train, y_train)

hg_pred = hg_classifier.predict(x_test)

print(classification_report(y_test, hg_pred))

hg_cm=confusion_matrix(y_test, hg_pred)
hg_disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix = hg_cm)

ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_estimator(hg_classifier, x_test, y_test, cmap="Reds")

```

```{python}
rf_classifier = RandomForestClassifier(n_jobs=-8, random_state=28)
rf_classifier.fit(x_train, y_train)

rf_pred = rf_classifier.predict(x_test)

print(classification_report(y_test, rf_pred))

rf_cm=confusion_matrix(y_test, rf_pred)
rf_disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix = rf_cm)

ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_estimator(rf_classifier, x_test, y_test, cmap="Greens")

```

__Decision Tree Classifier__
```{python}
# Descision Tree
dt_result= permutation_importance(dt_classifier, x_test, y_test, n_repeats=4,random_state=28)

dt_perms_imp = pl.DataFrame({'importance':dt_result.importances_mean, 'vars':x_train.columns})

print(classification_report(y_test, dt_pred))
print(dt_perms_imp.sort(['importance'], descending=True))
```

__Extra Tree Classifier__
```{python}
# Extra Tree
et_result= permutation_importance(et_classifier, x_test, y_test, n_repeats=4,random_state=28)

et_perms_imp = pl.DataFrame({'importance':et_result.importances_mean, 'vars':x_train.columns})

print(classification_report(y_test, et_pred))
print(et_perms_imp.sort(['importance'], descending=True))
```
